title: The Knight of the Whispering Woods
moral: True courage means choosing others over yourself.

story: Sir Cedric enters the Whispering Woods to rescue Lady Elenora and find the Heartstone. Along the way, he solves riddles, faces magical creatures, and learns that courage is not just about fighting but about wisdom and compassion. Discovering his true identity, he is faced with a choice between power and sacrifice. Choosing to save others, he defeats the Shadow Lord and restores peace. Cedric becomes a true hero by putting others before himself.
